## Short Summary

Ankit Raj Maurya is a Full-Stack Developer, Product Builder, and Creative Developer from Muzaffarpur, Bihar, India. He builds practical digital products, developer tools, and web applications with Node.js, Express.js, React, Next.js, JavaScript, and MongoDB. He serves as a Core Team Member and Team Lead at Codex Monarch and is developing the ReadyToGo programming and placement preparation platform.
